blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A working-memory model must remember stimuli and use its memory flexibly to perform different tasks. Here we introduce a model of working memory for images that combines dynamic activity with temporary associations between image features. We train the model on five tasks, including remembering a sample while other images are presented, categorizing distractor images while remembering the sample, and determining whether an image is new or has been presented before. The same trained model performs all tasks, guided by explicit cues about which response is required. We use this flexible memory model to ask how delay, distraction, and image history affect performance. Delays have little effect on sample-memory performance for the delays we tested, while seeing more images leads to more false alarms even when the target image appeared equally recently in all cases. On the sample-memory-plus-categorization task, the probability of correct responses on all questions decreases as more questions are asked, despite robust sample-memory performance. Finally, the model maintains stable performance across 40 brief trials of each task under the tested conditions. Together, these results demonstrate how a single working-memory system can be flexibly used to perform different tasks, and how its errors depend on both previous images and task demands.
blocks.zh: 工作记忆模型必须记住刺激,并灵活地利用其记忆来完成不同的任务. 在这里,我们引入了一个图像工作记忆模型,将动态活性与图像特征之间的临时关联结合起来. 我们根据五项任务来训练模型,包括在展示其他图像的同时记住一个样本,在记住样本的同时对分心者图像进行分类,以及确定一个图像是新图像还是之前呈现过的. 同样的训练有素的模式执行所有任务,以明确的指示为指导,需要做出何种反应。 我们用这个灵活的记忆模型来询问延迟,分心,图像历史如何影响性能. 延迟对我们测试的延迟的样本-记忆性能影响不大,同时看到更多的图像会导致更多的假警报,即使目标图像在所有情况下最近都同样出现. 在样本-记忆-加-分类任务上,对所有问题的正确答复概率会随着更多的问题的提出而降低,尽管样本-记忆性表现强劲. 最后,该模型在试验条件下对每项任务的40个简短审判中保持了稳定的业绩。 这些结果共同显示了一个单一的工作-记忆系统如何能够灵活地用于执行不同的任务,以及它的错误如何取决于以前的图像和任务要求.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Imagine that a computational model is shown a sequence of three images: a cat, a dog, and then the same dog. For a task to remember the first image, the correct response to the last image would be NO; in a task to detect repeated images, the correct response would be YES. Thus, a working-memory model must not only remember images but flexibly use this memory to solve different tasks. Here, we train a single model on five working-memory tasks. On some tasks, it must remember a cued sample image while other images are presented. On others, it must determine whether the current image has been seen before. On one task, it must categorize distractor images while remembering the sample for a final matching response. We use explicit task cues to instruct the model on what response is appropriate.
blocks.zh: 想象一下一个计算模型会显示一个由三个图像组成的序列:一只猫,一只狗,然后是同一个狗. 对于要记住第一个图像的任务,对最后一个图像的正确反应是NO;在检测重复图像的任务中,正确的反应是Yes. 因此,工作记忆模型不仅必须记住图像,而且必须灵活地使用这个记忆来解决不同的任务. 在这里,我们训练一个单一的模型 五个工作记忆任务。 在一些任务上,它必须记住一个提示的样本图像,而其他图像则被显示. 在另一些方面,它必须确定现在的图像是否以前见过。 在一个任务上,它必须分类分辨器图像,同时记住样本进行最终匹配响应. 我们使用明确的任务提示来指示模型应采取何种对策。

blocks.en: Persistent or dynamic activity and rapidly changing associations have been proposed as potential mechanisms of working memory ( Masse et al., 2019 ; Danihelka et al., 2016 ; Schlag et al., 2021 ) . WorM has trained recurrent neural networks and Transformers on a suite of working-memory tasks and compared their performance to humans ( Sikarwar and Zhang, 2023 ) , and HebbFF has used learned synaptic plasticity to perform continual familiarity detection ( Tyulmankov et al., 2022 ) . Our model builds on these previous efforts, and our tasks unify aspects of previous tasks, such as matching a test to a sample, processing other images during a memory delay, and detecting repetitions. By using the same model on different tasks, we can ask how task demands impact model behavior.
blocks.zh: 提议将持续或动态的活动和迅速变化的协会作为潜在的工作记忆机制(Masse等人,2019年;Danihelka等人,2016年;Schlag等人,2021年)。 WorM曾就一套工作记忆任务对反复出现的神经网络和变形器进行了培训,并将其性能与人类进行比较(Sikarwar和Zhang,2023年),HebbFF也利用所学的突触可塑性进行连续的熟悉度检测(Tyulmankov等人,2022年). 我们的模式以这些以前的努力为基础,我们的任务统一了以前的任务的方方面面,例如将一个测试与样本匹配,在内存延迟期间处理其他图像,以及检测重复. 通过在不同的任务中使用相同的模型,我们可以问任务如何要求影响模型的行为.

blocks.en: Here we first introduce our tasks and flexible working-memory model. Next, we ask how performance changes with increasing delays and image histories, and across 40 short trials. Finally, we examine how activity and associations contribute to memory by comparing our full model to models trained to use only one type of memory, as well as to two other architectures.
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们首先介绍我们的任务和灵活的工作模式。 其次,我们问,业绩如何随着拖延和形象历史的增加而改变,以及经历40次短期审判。 最后,我们审查活动和协会如何通过将我们的完整模型与只使用一种类型的记忆以及另外两种结构的模型进行比较来为记忆作出贡献。

blocks.en: 1.1 Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.1 缴款

blocks.en: • We introduce a flexible working-memory model that can be cued to perform five different memory tasks. • We show how dynamic activity and rapidly changing associations contribute to performance, with benefits that depend on the task. • We characterize how delays, distractors, and previously seen images impact performance on different memory tasks.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们采用了一种灵活的工作记忆模式,可以用来执行五个不同的记忆任务。 我们显示活跃的活动和迅速变化的协会如何促进业绩,其好处取决于任务。 我们描述的是延迟、分散注意力和以前看到的图像如何影响不同的内存任务。

blocks.en: We introduce a flexible working-memory model that can be cued to perform five different memory tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了一种灵活的工作记忆模型,可以用来执行五个不同的记忆任务。

blocks.en: We show how dynamic activity and rapidly changing associations contribute to performance, with benefits that depend on the task.
blocks.zh: 我们显示活跃的活动和迅速变化的协会如何促进业绩,其好处取决于任务。

blocks.en: We characterize how delays, distractors, and previously seen images impact performance on different memory tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们描述的是延迟、分散注意力和以前看到的图像如何影响不同的内存任务。

blocks.en: 2 Task design
blocks.zh: 2个 任务设计

blocks.en: Our five working-memory tasks use foreground images of objects on neutral backgrounds, with blank intervals between images (Figure 1 ). On Tasks 1–3, the model must remember a cued sample. On Tasks 4–5, it must determine whether images have appeared earlier in the current trial.
blocks.zh: 我们的五个工作-记忆任务在中性背景上使用对象的前景图像,图像之间有空白间隔(图1). 在任务 1–3 上, 模型必须记住提示的样本 。 在任务4-5上,它必须确定图像是否在目前的试验中较早出现.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Tasks performed by our working-memory model. On Tasks 1–3, the model must report whether the test image matches the cued sample image. On Task 3, it must also categorize the distractor images presented during the delay. On Tasks 4–5, it must report whether any image repeats (Task 4) or whether each image has been presented before (Task 5). Responses shown are ground truth, not model responses or inputs. The transformed example is an altered version of the same photograph.
blocks.zh: 图1:我们的工作记忆模型所执行的任务。 在任务 1–3 上, 模型必须报告测试图像是否匹配提示的样本图像 。 在任务3上,它还必须对延迟期间呈现的分散图像进行分类. 在任务4-5上,它必须报告是否有任何图像重复(任务4),或者每个图像是否在之前被呈现(任务5). 所显示的答复是基本事实,而不是模范的答复或投入。 变形的例子是同一照片的变形版本.

blocks.en: The model sees a sample image, a delay with no image, and then a test image. It must report whether the test image matches the sample.
blocks.zh: 模型看到一个样本图像,一个没有图像的延迟,然后是测试图像. 它必须报告测试图像是否匹配样本.

blocks.en: Like Task 1, but other images are presented during the delay and the model must not respond to them. Importantly, if the final test image is one of these distractors, the correct response is still NO because this image is not the sample.
blocks.zh: 和"任务1"一样,但其他图像在延迟时会呈现,模型不得响应. 重要的是,如果最后的测试图像是这些分光器之一,正确的反应仍然是NO,因为这个图像不是样本.

blocks.en: Like Task 2, but the model must also categorize each image presented during the delay. We score these categorization responses separately from sample-memory performance. Complete-trial success requires every category response and the final sample-memory response to be correct.
blocks.zh: 像"任务2"一样,但模型还必须对延迟期间呈现的每个图像进行分类. 我们对这些分类答复的分数与样本-模拟性能分开。 审判的圆满成功要求每个类别的答复和最后的样本-模拟答复是正确的。

blocks.en: The model sees a sequence of images and does not make responses during the sequence. At the end, it must report whether any image repeated. There is no cued sample image, and the final question is not associated with an image.
blocks.zh: 模型看到图像的序列,不会在序列中做出响应. 最后,它必须报告是否有任何图像重复。 没有提示的样本图像,最后的问题与图像无关.

blocks.en: The model must make a response after each image, reporting whether it has been presented before in the trial. Each image’s first appearance requires NO, and later appearances require YES. The model makes this response before the image is added to its memory.
blocks.zh: 模型必须在每个图像后做出回应,报告在审判前是否已经呈现出来. 每个图像的首次出现需要NO,以后的出现需要是. 该模型在图像被添加到其内存之前会做出这个响应.

blocks.en: Importantly, on all tasks images from the same category but depicting different objects, such as two different chairs, are not considered matches. The model receives cues specifying the task, the requested response, timing and image count, trial context, and the role of each image. It does not receive object identities, category labels, future sequence length or correct answers. Each trial starts a new relevant history, although internal memory can carry over from the previous trial. Thus, an image seen on a previous trial can be familiar without counting as a repetition in the current trial. The delay and image-history experiments use repetitions of identical images. The forty-trial sessions can include different renderings of the same source object. Neither study tests recognition across different photographs of the same object.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,在所有任务中,来自同一类别但描绘不同物体的图像,例如两个不同的椅子,不被认为是匹配的。 模型接收提示,指定任务,请求的响应,时间和图像计数,试验背景,以及每个图像的作用. 它不接收对象身份,分类标签,未来序列长度或正确的答案. 每个审判开始一个新的相关历史,虽然内部记忆可以延续前一次审判. 因此,在以前的审判中看到的形象是熟悉的,而不计入目前的审判中的重复。 延迟和图像-历史实验使用相同图像的重复. 第四十四届开庭可以包括同一源对象的不同渲染. 两个研究都没有对同一物体的不同照片进行识别测试。

blocks.en: 3 The shared memory model
blocks.zh: 3个 共享内存模式

blocks.en: Our model has two types of rapidly changing, temporary memories: an activity state, h ∈ ℝ 64 h\in\mathbb{R}^{64} , and associations, F ∈ ℝ 64 × 64 F\in\mathbb{R}^{64\times 64} (Figure 2 ). Activity changes based on the current image and information read out of the associations, which link keys (inputs used to access memories) with values (information representing image content). Context and role cues modify the key used to access memories, so that the same image can be remembered differently under different instructions. Throughout a trial, h h and F F change, but the model’s learned parameters remain fixed.
blocks.zh: 我们的模型有两种迅速变化的暂时记忆:一种是活动状态,h R 64h\in\mathb{R}^{64}和关联状态,F∈R 64×64 F\in\mathb{R}^{64\times 64}(图2). 活动变化基于当前图像和从关联中读出的信息,将密钥(用于访问记忆的输入)和值(代表图像内容的信息)联系起来. 背景和角色提示修改了用于访问记忆的密钥,这样在不同的指令下可以以不同的方式记住相同的图像. 在一次试验中,hh和FF变化,但模型的学习参数保持不变。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Schematic of our working-memory model. Activity ( h h ) and associations ( F F ) change over time. Context and role cues modify the keys that address the associations. Responses combine activity, retrieved content, image features and cues; category responses also receive normalized image features directly. The model answers from aged memory before writing the current image. Task 4 uses the largest local recognition score and image count for its final answer.
blocks.zh: 图2:我们的工作记忆模型图。 活动(hh)和协会(FF)随时间而变化。 背景和角色提示修改了针对关联的密钥. 反应结合了活动,检索的内容,图像特征和提示;分类反应也直接收到正常化的图像特征. 模型在写入当前图像之前会从旧记忆中解答. 任务4使用最大的本地识别分数和图像计数来进行最终答案.

blocks.en: 3.1 Encoding images
blocks.zh: 3.1 编码图像

blocks.en: We used a pretrained, frozen DINOv2 encoder ( Oquab and others, 2024 ) to transform images into 384-dimensional feature vectors. These features were normalized to unit length and then standardized using statistics from the training data. A learned linear layer followed by a tanh activation transformed them into 64-dimensional image representations.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个预先训练,冷冻的DINOv2编码器(Oquab等人,2024年)将图像转换成384维特性矢量. 这些特性已恢复正常化为单位长度,然后利用培训数据的统计数据实现标准化。 学习到的线性图层,然后是Thanh激活,将它们转化为64维图像表示.

blocks.en: 3.2 Responding
blocks.zh: 3.2 答复

blocks.en: The model’s key for the current image is used to read a value out of the associations. The model’s recognition score uses this value, the activity state, features from the current image, and public cues. For this response, both memory states are aged through the image’s exposure before they are read. We also provide the model with “retrieval cosine”: the cosine similarity between the retrieved value and the current image’s value, which compares their directions while ignoring their magnitudes. Tasks 1–3 and 5 use this shared score with their respective cues and calibrated response rules. On Task 3, category responses use the shared reader inputs plus a direct pathway from standardized image features. On Task 4, the final response combines the maximum unthresholded local recognition score over the trial with a learned adjustment for image count. This response follows a question cue with no image. The same network serves all five tasks; we did not train five separate models.
blocks.zh: 该模型用于当前图像的密钥用于读取关联值 。 该模型的识别分数使用这个值,活动状态,来自当前图像的特征,以及公共提示. 对于这个反应,两个记忆状态在被读取前都通过图像曝光而老化. 我们还向模型提供“检索余弦”:检索值与当前图像值之间的余弦相似性,比较其方向而忽略其大小。 任务1–3和5使用此共享的分数与各自的提示和校准的响应规则. 关于任务3,分类答复使用共享的阅读器输入以及标准化图像特性的直接路径。 在"任务4"上,最终的响应结合了试播集的最大无门槛本地识别分数与图像计数的学习调整. 此回复遵循一个没有图像的提问提示 。 同一个网络服务于所有五个任务;我们没有培训五个不同的模式。

blocks.en: 3.3 Updating memories
blocks.zh: 3.3 更新记忆

blocks.en: Both memory states decay as time passes. When an image appears, the current image, activity, retrieved content and cues determine an activity drive and update rates, which stay fixed during its exposure. Activity moves toward this drive while decaying. Associations are updated so that the value retrieved by the image’s key moves toward the current image’s value ( Schlag et al., 2021 ) . The model answers from memory aged through the exposure before committing these updates. Its predicted answer does not determine what is written. Appendix B summarizes the implementation.
blocks.zh: 两种记忆都会随着时间的流逝而衰败. 当图像出现时,当前图像、活动、检索的内容和提示会决定活动驱动器和更新率,在曝光期间保持固定。 活动在衰变时向这个驱动器移动. 关联被更新, 以便图像键取的值向当前图像值移动(Schlag等人, 2021年)。 该模型在进行这些更新之前,从陈旧的记忆中解答。 它的预言答案不能决定什么是书写的. 附录B总结了执行情况。

blocks.en: 3.4 Training
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训

blocks.en: We used COCO images ( Lin et al., 2014 ) , splitting the photographs into sets used to train the model’s weights (1,920), choose between checkpoints (480), calibrate its responses (480), and assess performance during development (960). We trained three models with different random initializations for 6,000 gradient updates. Half of the training objective covers Tasks 1–5, including category responses on Task 3 and local repetition labels as well as the final answer on Task 4. The other half teaches context membership, designated-item recognition and role recognition.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了COCO图像(Lin等人,2014年),将照片分成用于训练模型重量(1,920)的套件,在检查站之间选择(480),校准反应(480),并评估开发期间的表现(960)。 我们训练了三种模型 不同的随机初始化 6000梯度更新。 培训目标的一半涉及任务1至5,包括关于任务3的类别答复和当地重复标签以及任务4的最后答复。 另一半教授背景成员、指定项目承认和角色承认。

blocks.en: We chose checkpoints based on loss on photographs used only for model selection, and calibrated probability estimates and YES/NO rules using a separate set of photographs. The selected weights and calibrated response rules remain fixed in all experiments below. Appendix C gives the training ranges, objective weights and selection procedure.
blocks.zh: 我们根据只用于模型选择的照片损失情况选择了检查站,并使用一套单独的照片对概率估计和 " 是/否 " 规则进行了校准。 在下面的所有实验中,选定的重量和校准反应规则仍然固定不变. 附 录 C提供培训范围、客观加权和甄选程序。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We used the development images and all three models described above for these controlled experiments. On Task 1, we kept the sample and query images fixed while varying the blank delay. On Tasks 2 and 3, we kept the sample, query and time to the answer fixed while varying the number of distractors. On Tasks 4 and 5, we kept the target and final query images fixed while varying the number of images. Balanced accuracy gives equal weight to the rates of correct matching and nonmatching answers, or repeat and new-image answers. In Task 3, complete-trial success requires every category answer and the final memory answer to be correct.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了开发图像和上述所有三种模型来进行这些受控实验。 在任务1上,我们保留了样本和查询图像的固定,同时改变空白延迟. 在任务2和任务3上,我们保留样本,查询和时间到答案的固定,同时改变分散器的数量. 在任务4和5上,我们保留了目标和最终查询图像的固定,同时改变图像的数量. 平衡精度对正确匹配和不匹配的答案,或重复和新图像答案的速率给予同等的权重. 在任务3中,完成审判的成功要求每个类别答案和最后的内存答案正确.

blocks.en: Figure 3: The same pictures under increasing memory demands. (a) Task 1: forty fixed sample–query pairs across blank delays. (b,c) Sample matching with novel nonmatching queries, with sample-response age fixed at 65 time units. (c) Category answers and complete-trial success are scored separately. (d) Familiar distractors used as wrong queries. (e,f) Longer image sequences compared with equal-duration blanks containing only two images; Task 5 shows the last response. Means average three models. Bars are exploratory 95% intervals over twelve photograph groups; (a) is descriptive. Small markers show model means except for category accuracy. Gray regions exceed training support. Lines connect the tested conditions, spaced equally for display.
blocks.zh: 图3:内存需求增加情况下的相同图片. (a) 任务1:40个固定的样本 -- -- 隔空拖延。 (b,c) 样本与新的非匹配查询匹配,样本响应年龄固定在65个时间单位. (c) 分类答案和完全审判成功分别打分。 (d) 用作错误查询的熟悉者。 (e,f) 与只包含两个图像的等长空白相比,图像序列更长;任务5显示最后一个响应. 表示平均有三种型号. 栏杆在12个摄影组之间间隔95%; (a)是描述性的。 小标记显示的模型除了类别精度以外都表示. 格雷地区超过了培训支助。 线路连接测试的条件, 平空显示 。

blocks.en: 4.1 Effects of delay and image history
blocks.zh: 4.1 延迟和图像历史的影响

blocks.en: For Task 1 (Figure 3 a), mean performance (balanced accuracy across 40 sample–query pairs) without a delay was 92.5% and with a delay of 256 model time units was 94.2%.
blocks.zh: 就任务1(图3a)而言,平均性能(40个样本的平衡精度)为92.5%,延迟256个模型时间单位为94.2%。

blocks.en: Memory states decay during a blank delay interval, but balanced accuracy remained high over the tested delays. While decay leads to a uniformly scaled associative memory matrix, for a given query this has no effect on the direction of memory retrieval, provided retrieval remains nonzero. Thus similarity information can be maintained even as the overall strength of memory decreases, although this alone does not explain the model’s responses.
blocks.zh: 内存在空白延迟间隔期间会衰变,但相对于测试的延迟,平衡准确度仍然很高. 虽然衰变会导致一个统一缩放的关联内存矩阵,但对于一个给定的查询来说,这对内存检索的方向没有影响,只要检索仍然不为零. 因此,即使记忆的总强度下降,也可以保持相似性信息,尽管单凭这一点并不能解释模型的反应。

blocks.en: For Tasks 2 and 3 (Figure 3 b,c,d), sample-matching performance was high (balanced accuracy above 97% and 95% in Tasks 2 and 3, respectively) when the incorrect query was a novel image. When the incorrect query was a familiar distractor image, performance varied: in Task 2 the model responded YES to all incorrect queries when there was one distractor, and to 8.3% when there were 16; in Task 3 the model responded YES to 15.3% when there was either one or 16 distractors. Adding more distractors did not uniformly degrade performance, even though the identity and elapsed time since presentation of the incorrect query image were held constant.
blocks.zh: 对于任务2和3(图3 b,c,d),当错误的查询是新图像时,样本比对性能很高(在任务2和3中,平衡准确度分别高于97%和95%). 当不正确的查询是熟悉的分心者图像时,性能各异:在任务2中,当有一个分心者时,模型对所有不正确的查询作出是的回答,在16个分心者时,模型答复为8.3%;在任务3中,当有一个或16个分心者时,模型答复为是的15.3%。 添加更多的分散分光器并不能统一降低性能,尽管自不正确的查询图像呈现以来,其身份和时间一直保持不变。

blocks.en: In Task 3, accuracy for individual category responses remained relatively high (about 80%), but the percentage of trials with correct responses to all category questions and the sample-matching question decreased as the number of distractors increased (76.4%, 31.9%, and 9.7% for 1, 8, and 16 distractors, respectively; Figure 3 c). Sample-matching performance in isolation remained high. Performance on the full trial was directly measured, not estimated by multiplying accuracies.
blocks.zh: 在任务3中,个别类别答复的准确性仍然相对较高(约80%),但对所有类别问题作出正确答复的试验百分比和样本比对问题随着分流器数量增加而下降(分别是76.4%、31.9%和9.7%的1、8和16个分流器;图3c)。 单独抽样匹配的性能仍然很高。 全部审判的成绩直接衡量,不是用乘法来估计。

blocks.en: For Tasks 4 and 5 (Figure 3 e,f), performance decreased as the number of images increased from 4 to 64 (balanced accuracy on the terminal question decreased from 97.9% to 52.1% in Task 4, and balanced accuracy on the last query decreased from 92.4% to 67.4% in Task 5). Interestingly, in Task 5 performance was slightly higher after seeing 8 images compared to after 4. False-alarm rate increased from 4.2% to 91.7% in Task 4 and from 15.3% to 51.4% in Task 5 as list length increased from 4 to 64 images.
blocks.zh: 对于任务4和5(图3 e,f),由于图像数量从4个增加到64个,性能下降(在任务4中,终端问题的准确度从97.9%下降到52.1%,在任务5中,上次查询的准确度从92.4%下降到67.4%)。 有趣的是,在"任务5"中,在看到8幅图像后的表现略高于4幅之后. 在任务4中,假警报率从4.2%增加到91.7%,在任务5中,从15.3%增加到51.4%,因为列表长度从4张增加到64张。

blocks.en: When we presented blank delays instead of images between the target and query images (matching the total amount of time between these two images), performance remained high (balanced accuracy of 97.2% and 94.4% for the longest duration in Tasks 4 and 5, respectively). This indicates that the passage of time alone does not explain the decrease in performance, although this change also affected the number of memory updates and images seen, and in Task 4 also affected the information used for answering the question. Thus we cannot isolate which of these changes caused the impaired performance with images. In these experiments only the last image could be repeated, so in Task 5 we report performance on the last query, not averaged across the sequence.
blocks.zh: 当我们呈现空白的延迟而不是目标图像和查询图像之间的图像(对比这两个图像之间的总时间)时,性能仍然很高(在任务4和任务5中分别为97.2%和94.4%)。 这表明时间的流逝本身并不能解释性能下降的原因,尽管这一变化也影响了所看到的内存更新和图像的数量,在任务4中也影响了用于回答问题的信息. 因此,我们不能将这些变化中哪些变化用图像造成性能受损。 在这些实验中,只能重复最后的图像,因此在任务5中,我们在最后的查询中报告性能,而不是跨序列的平均值.

blocks.en: 4.2 Earlier history with equally recent targets
blocks.zh: 4.2 具有同样近期目标的历史

blocks.en: In Tasks 4 and 5 increasing the number of images between the target and query images also increased the amount of time since the target image was seen. To tease apart these effects we compared performance on sequences of 16 and 64 images which were identical from the target image onward (with either zero, three, or seven images presented between the target and query images; the 64-image sequence contained 48 additional novel images before the target image). Averaged across these conditions, balanced accuracy decreased from 70.8% to 53.5% in Task 4 and from 88.9% to 72.9% in Task 5 as sequence length increased from 16 to 64 images (Figure 4 ), and these effects remained significant after correcting for the nine planned comparisons. Hit rate for repeated images remained high (98–100%) while false-alarm rate increased from 56.5% to 91.7% in Task 4 and from 22.2% to 52.3% in Task 5, indicating that novel images seen earlier in the sequence can lead to false familiarity even when controlling for the recency of the target image. This controls target age, but changes the number of images and memory updates, the memory state before the target and, in Task 4, the information accumulated for the final answer. We therefore cannot tease apart these potential causes of impaired performance.
blocks.zh: 在任务4和任务5中,增加目标图像和查询图像之间的图像数量,也增加了目标图像被看到后的时间. 为了区分这些效果,我们比较了16和64图像的序列的性能,这些图像与目标图像的上行完全相同(在目标图像和查询图像之间显示的是零、3或7个图像;64图像序列包含在目标图像之前的另外48个新图像)。 根据这些条件,在任务4中,平均精确度从70.8%下降到53.5%,在任务5中,平均精确度从88.9%下降到72.9%,因为序列长度从16幅增加到64幅(图4),这些效果在纠正了计划的9幅比较之后仍然很大。 重复图像的点击率仍然很高(98–100%),而假警报率在任务4中从56.5%上升至91.7%,在任务5中从22.2%上升至52.3%,这表明在序列中早期看到的新图像即使在控制目标图像的正确性时也会导致错误的熟悉. 这可以控制目标年龄,但会改变图像和内存更新的数量,目标前的内存状态,并在任务4中改变为最终答案积累的信息. 因此,我们不能把造成业绩受损的这些潜在原因分开。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Longer histories with equally recent targets. The target, query and images between them were identical across lengths. The longer sequence contained 48 additional unique images before the target; neither condition added a blank delay. Means average twelve photograph groups and three models. Open points show individual model means, and bars show descriptive 95% intervals over photograph groups. Length 64 exceeds training support. Appendix Table 4 reports the two length comparisons with intervals adjusted across all nine planned comparisons.
blocks.zh: 图4:具有同样近期目标的长期历史。 它们之间的目标、查询和图像长短相同。 更长的序列包含在目标之前另外48个独特的图像;两个条件都增加了空白延迟. 表示平均十二组照片和三个模型. 开放点显示单个模型表示,条显示描述性95%间隔于照片组. 64年的长度超过了培训支助。 附录表4报告了两个长度比较,对所有九个计划比较的间隔作了调整。

blocks.en: We also varied blank delay alongside sample exposure (Task 1), distractor count (Tasks 2 and 3), or sequence length (Tasks 4 and 5). The added delay occurred after sample presentation in Task 1, after the distractor schedule in Tasks 2 and 3, and before the final query image in Tasks 4 and 5, not before Task 4’s image-free answer. Added blank delay is distinct from the total time since the sample or target image, which can also include intervening images. None of the seven planned comparisons assessing an interaction with delay established an effect after correction across all nine planned comparisons (see Appendix D for all planned comparisons and a full grid of results).
blocks.zh: 我们还在样本曝光(任务1),分心器计数(任务2和3),或序列长度(任务4和5)的同时,对空白延迟进行了不同处理。 附加的延迟发生在任务1的样本演示之后,在任务2和3的分流器调度之后,在任务4和5的最后查询图像之前,而不是任务4的无图像解答之前。 添加的空白延迟不同于样本或目标图像以来的总时间,这也可以包括介入图像. 评估与延迟的相互作用的7项计划比较没有一个在对所有9项计划比较进行更正后确定效果(所有计划比较和整套结果见附录D)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Forty short trials
blocks.zh: 4.3 40起短期审判

blocks.en: In order to assess performance over the course of a session, we presented forty trials in each session, using cyclic rotations such that each of forty fixed trials appeared in each of forty trial positions. With memory carried between trials, performance changed little from the first ten to last ten trials (range of changes across nine fixed conditions spanning all five tasks: − 0.08 -0.08 to + 0.50 +0.50 percentage points; see Appendix Table 5 for full results). This is a descriptive range of performance changes, not an average change or a significance test. Thus, even when performance on an individual longer trial may be impaired, overall performance across a session made up of shorter trials can remain stable. This does not mean that the model can successfully retain a memory of one sample image for all forty trials; each trial is a distinct bounded task, and these experiments assess repeated use rather than retention of the same sample across the session.
blocks.zh: 为了在一届会议期间评估业绩,我们在每届会议上提出40项审判,采用循环轮换,使40项固定审判中的每一项都出现在40项审判职位上。 由于在两次审判之间都有内存,从头10次审判到最后10次审判(涉及所有五项任务的9个固定条件的变化范围:−0.08-008至+0.50+0.50个百分点;全部结果见附录表5)。 这是业绩变化的描述范围,而不是平均变化或意义测试. 因此,即使个别较长期审判的业绩可能受到影响,但由较短审判组成的整个开庭期间的总体业绩仍可以保持稳定。 这并不意味着该模型能够为所有40个试验成功保留一个样本图像的内存;每个试验都是一个截然不同的界限内的任务,这些试验评估的是重复使用而不是在整个会议期间保留同一个样本。

blocks.en: 5 What do the two memories contribute?
blocks.zh: 页:1 这两个记忆有什么贡献?

blocks.en: We next sought to better understand the contributions of each type of memory by training models with only one type of learned memory: either only the activity state or only the associative memory matrix. We also trained a causal Transformer and a Gated DeltaNet model. All models were trained to perform the same set of tasks with the same number of training updates, but were not otherwise matched for memory size, compute, or convergence. Table 1 shows results across a wider range of delays, sequence lengths, and exposures than in previous sections, including some conditions outside of training support.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们试图通过培训模式更好地了解每一种记忆的贡献,这些模式只有一种类型的学习记忆:要么是活动状态,要么是关联记忆矩阵。 我们还培训了一个因果变形器和一个Gated DeltaNet模型。 所有模型都经过了培训,以同样数量的培训更新来完成相同的一组任务,但因内存大小、计算或趋同而没有得到其他匹配。 表1显示与前几节相比,在更广泛的延误、序列长度和暴露方面取得的成果,包括培训支助以外的一些条件。

blocks.en: Table 1: Performance across the broad task battery (%). Tasks 1, 2, 4 and 5 report balanced accuracy across responses; Task 3 reports the percentage of trials with every response correct. Values average three trained models, using each model’s source-calibrated response rules and resetting memory between trials. Activity-only and associations-only models were trained separately. Equal training-update budgets do not match memory capacity, computation or convergence.
blocks.zh: 表1:大任务电池的性能(%)。 任务1、2、4和5报告答复的准确性平衡; 任务3报告每项答复正确的审判百分比。 平均值为3个训练有素的模型,使用每个模型的源调节响应规则,并在试验间重置内存. 仅培训活动模式和社团模式。 相同的培训更新预算不符合内存能力、计算或趋同。

blocks.en: Different types of memory were most beneficial for different tasks. The model with only activity-based memory had the highest mean performance on Tasks 1 and 2, while the model with only association-based memory had the highest mean performance on Tasks 3 and 4, and exceeded the full model’s mean on four out of five tasks. For Task 5, performance of the full model was 12.48 percentage points higher than the model with only activity-based memory (exploratory 95% interval: [11.02, 13.78]), while the full model exceeded the model with only association-based memory by 0.86 percentage points (exploratory 95% interval: [0.41, 1.35]). Mean performance on Task 3 (fraction of trials on which all responses were correct) was higher for the full model than for both the Transformer and Gated DeltaNet models, but the Transformer had the highest mean performance on Task 5. These comparisons concern models trained separately without a component, rather than components removed after training.
blocks.zh: 不同类型的记忆对于不同的任务最为有益. 仅以活动为主的记忆模式在任务1和2上的平均性能最高,而仅以关联为主的记忆模式在任务3和4上的平均性能最高,在五个任务中,四个任务超过了完整的模型的平均值. 对于任务5,完整模型的性能比只有活动内存的模型高出12.48个百分点(探索95%的间隔:[11.02,13.78]),而完整模型仅以关联内存超过模型0.86个百分点(探索95%的间隔:[0.41,1.35]). 任务3(违反所有答复都正确的试验)的全部模型的平均业绩高于变形器和Gated DeltaNet模型,但变形器在任务5上的平均业绩最高。 这些比较涉及在没有组件的情况下单独培训的模式,而不是培训后删除的组件。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: We introduced a model that can memorize sample images, categorize other images, and make repetition judgments according to different task demands. Performance was impaired by additional images presented prior to the target (Tasks 4 and 5), and complete-trial success fell as the number of images to categorize increased (Task 3), while sample matching changed little over the tested delays. Other aspects of performance proved more robust, including sample memory in Task 3 and performance over a session made up of many short trials. We also demonstrated that temporary associations between image features can play an especially important role in supporting online repetition detection, and that different forms of memory make different contributions across these tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个模型,可以记住样本图像,将其他图像分类,并根据不同的任务要求进行重复判断. 业绩受到目标之前提出的额外图像(任务4和5)的损害,随着分类图像数量的增加(任务3),完成审判的成功率下降,而样本匹配在经过测试的延迟中变化不大。 业绩的其他方面证明更加有力,包括任务3的样本内存和由许多短期审判组成的会议的业绩。 我们还表明,图像特征之间的临时关联可以在支持在线重复检测方面发挥特别重要的作用,不同形式的内存在这些任务中做出不同的贡献.

blocks.en: Our model could be useful for generating testable predictions for experiments that record from the brain. Prior work has investigated the potential contributions of neural activity and short-term synaptic plasticity to working memory ( Masse et al., 2019 ) . In particular, Kozachkov et al. (2022) compared models with and without synaptic plasticity to neural activity recorded from prefrontal cortex while a non-human primate performed an object-memory task that included distractors. Our model could be used in a similar manner: neural activity recorded prior to, during, and after presentation of a distractor could be compared to activity from our full model and the model trained without associative memory, using matched stimuli, task demands, and timing. With model performance also taken into account, such an analysis could test on held-out trials whether associations help explain neural activity beyond differences in task accuracy. A separate behavioral experiment could test the prediction that more images presented prior to the target increase false familiarity even when target age is held fixed. While neural recordings may distinguish models with and without associations, they would not provide a direct readout of the associations stored in F F .
blocks.zh: 我们的模型可能有助于为大脑记录的实验 提供可测试的预测。 之前的工作调查了神经活性和短期突触可塑性对工作记忆的潜在贡献(Masse等人,2019年). 特别是,科扎奇科夫等人(2022年)将模型与前额皮层记录的神经活性进行比较,并且没有突触的可塑性,而非人类灵长类动物则执行包括分泌物在内的物体记忆任务. 我们的模型可以以类似的方式使用:在分心器出现之前、期间和之后记录的神经活动可以与我们整个模型的活动和没有关联记忆、使用匹配的刺激、任务要求和时间来训练的模型相比。 如果模型性能也得到考虑,这种分析可以检验搁置的试验是否有助于解释神经活动,而不是任务准确性的差异。 一个单独的行为实验可以测试这样的预测:即使目标年龄被固定,在目标之前呈现的更多图像也会增加虚假的熟悉度. 尽管神经录音可以区分有和没有关联的模型,但它们不会提供FF存储的关联的直接读取.

blocks.en: There are many potential extensions to our model. For instance, our model was provided with explicit information about task, trial boundaries, and time; future work could investigate how performance changes when such information is less explicit. Our model computed a decision variable for Task 4 using the largest local recognition score and an adjustment for image count; future work could investigate alternative strategies. Although we probed model performance on some sequence lengths and numbers of distractors that exceeded those seen during training, future work could investigate learning and performance on a wider range of task demands.
blocks.zh: 我们的模型有很多潜在的扩展。 例如,我们的模式得到了关于任务、审判界限和时间的明确信息;今后的工作可以调查在这种信息不太明确时业绩如何变化。 我们的模型利用当地最大的识别分数和图像计数的调整计算了任务4的决定变量;今后的工作可以调查其他战略。 虽然我们对一些序列长度和数量超过培训期间所看到分心器的模型性能进行了调查,但今后的工作可以对更广泛的任务需求的学习和性能进行调查。

blocks.en: Appendix A Data and evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据和评价

blocks.en: Unless otherwise specified, stimuli in behavioral experiments consisted of masked foreground objects presented on a neutral background on a 224 × 224 224\times 224 -pixel canvas. The image encoder and normalization statistics were fixed prior to model evaluation. We used disjoint sets of COCO photographs for training model weights (1,920), selecting model checkpoints (480), calibrating models (480), and development evaluation (960). We counted unique photographs rather than crops, renderings, or copies used as queries. For the experiment investigating readout of a fixed memory (Appendix E ), we used 32 groups of images from Open Images ( Kuznetsova et al., 2020 ) that we had previously used in other experiments, for a total of 1,024 photographs and 1,056 selected object instances. Each group included 31 support photographs and two anchor objects from the same category depicted in one additional photograph. These photographs were distinct from those used to fit readouts. Both the behavioral and same-memory assessments are exploratory because the photographs had already been examined. We did not establish whether the sets contained near duplicates or additional photographs of the same physical object, or whether any images overlapped with data used to pretrain the image encoder.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,行为实验中的刺激由在224×224\times 224-像素画布上以中性背景呈现的蒙面前缘物体组成. 图像编码器和正常化统计是在模型评价之前固定的。 我们使用不相连的COCO照片进行训练模型重量(1,920)、选择模型检查站(480)、校准模型(480)和发展评价(960)。 我们统计的是独特的照片,而不是作物、渲染物或用作查询的拷贝。 在研究读取固定内存的实验(Appendix E )中,我们使用了32组来自Open Images(Kuznetsova 等人,2020年)的图像,这是我们以前在其他实验中使用的,共计有1,024张照片和1,056个选定的物体实例. 每组包括31张辅助照片和另外一张照片中描绘的同一类的两件锚定物体。 这些照片不同于用来适合阅读的照片。 行为评估和同一记忆评估都是探索性的,因为这些照片已经过审查。 我们没有确定是否包含近似重复的集或同一物理对象的额外照片,也没有确定是否有任何图像与用于预排图像编码器的数据重叠.

blocks.en: Response age was defined as the time, in model units rather than milliseconds, from the offset of the earlier image through the end of the query exposure. Image lag was defined as the difference in image positions between the query and its most recent matching presentation; consecutive presentations have lag one. We report hit rates (the proportion of repeat or sample-match queries, depending on the task, that were endorsed) and false-alarm rates (the proportion of new or nonmatching queries, depending on the task, that were endorsed). Balanced accuracy is the average of hit rate and correct-rejection rate. For Task 3, we also report the proportion of trials on which the model made correct categorization judgments for all distractor images and a correct sample-memory judgment (complete-trial success); when no distractors were presented, this metric reduces to final sample-memory accuracy and categorization accuracy is undefined. We only included trials for which the model made all required responses. The reported confidence intervals describe the fixed trained models and do not include uncertainty from retraining or checkpoint selection.
blocks.zh: 反应年代被定义为从先前图像的抵消到查询曝光结束的时间,在模型单位而不是毫秒. 图像滞后被定义为查询与其最近匹配的演示文稿在图像位置上的区别;连续的演示文稿有滞后的. 我们报告命中率(重复或抽样对等查询的比例,视任务而定,得到认可)和假警报率(视任务而定,得到认可的新查询或不匹配查询的比例)。 平衡精度是命中率和正确拒绝率的平均值. 关于任务3,我们还报告模型对所有分散视线图像作出正确分类判断的试验比例以及正确的抽样-模拟判断(审判圆满成功);没有提出分散视线时,这一衡量尺度会降低到最后的抽样-模拟准确性,分类准确性没有界定。 我们只包括模型作出一切必要反应的审判。 所报告的信任间隔描述了经过培训的固定模式,不包括再培训或选择检查站的不确定性。

blocks.en: For the battery of tasks in Table 2 , we cleared memory between trials and pooled binary responses within each task, rather than scoring only the final query or averaging balanced accuracy across streams. Task 3’s complete-trial endpoint was scored separately. Accuracy on individual categorization responses, accuracy on all categorization responses, and complete-trial success are different metrics.
blocks.zh: 对于表2中的任务组合,我们清除了每个任务中试验和集合二进制响应之间的内存,而不是仅仅评分最后查询或平均各流的均衡准确性。 任务3的完整审判结束点分别得分. 个别分类答复的准确性、所有分类答复的准确性以及审判的完全成功,都是不同的衡量标准。

blocks.en: Table 2: Response counts per trained model. Tasks 1–4 have one final binary answer per trial; Task 3 adds 2,336 category answers. Task 5 has 1,792 answers in the length panel, 4,096 in 512-image streams and 3,072 in the exposure panel. Exposures are 0, 0.25, 1 or 4 units, with fixed-interval or matched-duration schedules.
blocks.zh: 表2:每个经过培训的模型的答复数。 任务1–4每次审判有一个最后的二进制答案;任务3增加了2,336个类别答案. 任务5在长度面板上有1,792个答案,在512图像流中有4,096个答案,在曝光面板中有3,072个答案. 接触量为0,0.25,1或4个单元,有固定的间距或匹配的延长时间表.

blocks.en: Appendix B Model specification
blocks.zh: 附录B 型号规格

blocks.en: The response model has 96- and 64-unit hidden layers and a comparison branch that learns its weights. Its inputs are current-image features, activity, retrieved content, their interactions and similarities, activity, retrieval and association norms, and public cues. The response model’s image input allows it direct access to the current image; exposure duration scales the effect of this input. Category responses also use a direct image pathway with a 96-unit hidden layer and 12 outputs.
blocks.zh: 反应模型有96-和64单元的隐藏层和一个比较分支来学习其权重. 它的投入是时空图像特征、活动、检索内容、互动和相似性、活动、检索和联系规范以及公共提示。 响应模型的图像输入允许它直接访问当前图像;曝光持续时间衡量这种输入的效果. 分类响应还使用直接图像路径,包含96个单元隐藏层和12个输出.

blocks.en: During blanks, activity and associations decay exponentially. When an image appears, the model computes a bounded target activity and activity and association update rates using the image features, previous activity, retrieved content and public cues; these values do not change for the duration of the exposure. During exposures, activity relaxes toward its target and decays; associations decay and adjust retrieved content toward the current image’s value vector. When forming a response, the model first ages its memory through the exposure duration, then reads activity and retrieved content before writing the current image. This retrieval differs from the retrieval at image onset. The model does not use its predicted response when updating memory. These rules define a transition that integrates decay and writing, given fixed update targets and rates.
blocks.zh: 在空白时期,活动和协会呈指数式衰减。 当图像出现时,模型利用图像特性,前期活动,检索的内容和公共提示计算出一个有界限的目标活动与活动和关联更新率;这些值在曝光期间没有变化. 在接触时,活动会放松到目标与衰变;关联衰变,并调整被检索的内容,使其符合当前图像的价值矢量。 当形成一个响应时,模型首先通过曝光持续时间对内存进行加长,然后读取活动并检索内容后再写入当前图像. 这种检索不同于图像启动时的检索 。 该模型在更新内存时不使用它的预测响应. 这些规则定义了结合衰变和写作的过渡,给定了固定的更新目标和速率.

blocks.en: At trial boundaries, the model advances its clock and ages memory, optionally resets or halves activity and associations, clears its decision summaries and advances the context cue. Half retention multiplies both memory components by one-half in addition to normal decay. For the first image in each trial, activity and associations are multiplied by learned task-dependent factors between zero and one. For the final response in Task 4, which does not depend on a current image, the model uses a learned scaling of the maximum local recognition score (without thresholding) and a learned adjustment based on how many images it has seen. All neural reference models use this final response procedure.
blocks.zh: 在试验边界,模型推进其时钟和年龄记忆,可选地重排或减半活动和关联,清除其决定摘要,并推进上下文提示。 除了正常衰变外,一半的留存量将两个内存元件乘以一半. 就每个试验的第一个图像而言,活动和关联乘以零到1之间的学习到的任务依赖因素。 对于任务4中不依赖于当前图像的最终响应,该模型使用学习到的本地最大识别分数(不设定阈值)的缩放,以及根据其所看到的图像数量进行的学习调整. 所有神经参考模型都使用这个最终反应程序.

blocks.en: Appendix C Training and reference models
blocks.zh: 附录C 培训和参考模式

blocks.en: We trained Tasks 1–5 with loss weight 0.1 each. Context membership, designated-item recognition and item-role recognition each had weight one-sixth. Binary responses used binary cross-entropy and category responses used 12-class cross-entropy. Within Task 3, we added final memory loss to mean category loss. Within Task 4, we added final response loss to one-quarter of mean local repetition loss, including nonrepeats. All other tasks used mean binary loss. We averaged over trials within each task, not questions, so adding questions does not down-weight Task 3’s final memory loss.
blocks.zh: 我们训练了任务1 -5 减重0.1。 背景成员、指定项目确认和项目作用确认各有六分之一的权重。 二进制响应使用二进制交叉式,类别响应使用十二级交叉式. 在"任务3"中,我们增加了最后的内存损失,指类别损失. 在任务4中,我们增加了当地平均重复损失的四分之一,包括非重复损失。 所有其他任务都使用了平均二进制损失. 我们平均在每项任务范围内进行试验,而不是提问,因此增加问题不会减少任务3的最后记忆损失。

blocks.en: For context exercises, we separately averaged binary and category losses, then averaged over episodes. For designated-item exercises, we weighted the positive example’s loss by one-half and each of the three negative examples’ losses by one-sixth. For item-role exercises, we equally weighted positive and negative losses, including wrong-role, previously unseen, neutral and prior-trial-only negatives, then averaged over role requests and role assignments. Context exercise memory loads were 1–4 items. Designated-item exercise memory loads were 2, 4 or 5 items and used 0–2 previous trials. Item-role exercise memory loads were 2 and 4 items and used both role assignments. We did not separately isolate the effects of these additional objectives.
blocks.zh: 对于上下文练习,我们分别平均二进制和类别损失,然后按事件平均。 对于指定项目的工作,我们把正面例子的损失加权为一半,把三个负面例子的损失各加权为六分之一。 就项目作用演习而言,我们同样权衡了积极和消极损失,包括错误作用、以前所未见的、中立的和仅审判前的负面损失,然后平均衡量角色要求和角色分配。 背景练习负载为 1–4 项 。 指定的项目练习内存负载为2,4或5件,并使用了0-2以前的试验. 项-作用锻炼内存负载为2项和4项,并使用了两项角色任务. 我们没有单独孤立这些额外目标的影响。

blocks.en: We trained from three random initializations for 6,000 AdamW optimizer steps with learning rate 0.001, weight decay 0.0001 and gradient-norm clipping at 5. Each step used ten four-trial histories (eight trials per task), four context episodes, two designated-item templates and four item-role templates, computing gradients over whole histories without truncation. Batches for different losses were independently initialized. Eight-time-unit boundaries used reset, half retention or carry. Blank durations (0, 16, 64 and 128), numbers of distractors (0, 1, 2 and 4), Task 4/5 list lengths (4, 8, 16 and 32) and image exposure durations (0.25, 1 and 4) were sampled during training. Training configurations specify short-query augmentation; four-trial histories can exceed the single-trial training length limit. During training, we evaluated four checkpoint-selection schedules at initialization and every 500 updates. For each initialization, we selected the checkpoint with the lowest average loss without response calibration, breaking ties toward earlier updates.
blocks.zh: 我们从3个随机初始化中训练了6000个亚当W优化步骤,学习速率0.001,重量衰减0.0001和梯度规范剪切5. 每一步骤都使用十种四审历史(每次审判八次)、四场上下文、两个指定项目模板和四个项目作用模板,计算整个历史的梯度而无需缩短。 不同损失的电池管被独立初始化. 八时单位边界使用重置,半保留或携带. 培训期间对空白持续时间(0、16、64和128)、分散干扰器数量(0、1、2和4)、任务4/5清单长度(4、8、16和32)和图像曝光持续时间(0.25、1和4)进行了抽样。 培训配置具体规定了短调加固;4个审判历史可以超过单一审判培训时限。 在培训期间,我们在初始化时评估了四个检查站选址时间表,每500次更新。 每次初始化时,我们选择平均损失最少的检查站,但没有进行响应校准,打破了与早期更新的联系。

blocks.en: We calibrated responses using held-out calibration photographs: five affine transformations with positive slopes, one each for Tasks 1–3 (sample), online repetition, final response, designated-item and item-role responses. Calibrated logits of zero or above predict YES. Categories have a positive temperature calibration that does not change which category has maximum probability. These transformations are fixed during evaluation. We used L-BFGS-B to minimize source-weighted binary cross-entropy, with source weights summing to one for each response policy. We used 1,873 feature rows from 479 of the 480 calibration photographs.
blocks.zh: 我们利用搁置的校准照片来校准反应:5个带正坡的近缘转变,任务1-3(样本)各一个,在线重复,最后反应,指定项目和项目作用反应。 校准的零或以上对数预测是。 类别有正温校准,不会改变哪个类别有最大概率。 这些转变在评价期间是固定的。 我们用L-BFGS-B 来尽量减少源重二进制横切,每一次反应策略的源重会合为一个. 我们使用了480张校准照片中的479张的1,873个特征行.

blocks.en: For ablations, we trained three models per component (activity and associations) from random initialization using the same procedure as above. Activity-only models zero associations before responses, updates and trial boundaries and disable association writes; associations-only models zero activity and its target. The remaining parameters were trained. Both retain image inputs, public cues, category responses and final summaries; they differ in capacity.
blocks.zh: 就模拟而言,我们利用与上述相同的程序,从随机初始化中培训了每个组成部分(活动和协会)的三个模型。 仅活动模式在回复,更新和试验边界之前为零关联,并禁用关联书写;仅活动模式为零活动及其目标. 其余参数都经过培训。 两者都保留图像输入、公开提示、分类答复和最后摘要;它们的能力各不相同。

blocks.en: The Transformer has two layers of width 128 with four attention heads and feed-forward layer width 256. Gated DeltaNet ( Yang et al., 2025 ) has two layers of width 128 with three attention heads, key and value widths 32 and 64, and width-4 convolutions; we use the model class from FLA with PyTorch reference operators. We trained three models per architecture from random initialization using the same losses, number of training steps and checkpoint-selection procedure. Unlike our model, reference models’ memories do not decay during blanks, although their clocks still advance. Unlike our model with fixed-size memory, the Transformer’s key/value memory grows with sequence length. Gated DeltaNet has fixed-size convolutional and recurrent memories. We did not match model size, computation or convergence.
blocks.zh: "变形器"有两层宽度128,有4个注意头和向导层宽度256. Gated DeltaNet(Yang et al.,2025)有两层宽度128,有3个注意头,键和值宽度32和64,宽度-4演化;我们使用FLA的模型级,有PyTorch参考操作员. 我们利用相同的损失、培训步骤的数目和检查站选择程序,从随机初始化中培训了每个建筑的三个模型。 与我们的模型不同,参考模型的记忆不会在空白时衰减,尽管它们的时钟仍然在前进. 与我们拥有固定大小内存的模型不同,变形器的密钥/值内存会随着序列长度增长. Gated DeltaNet拥有固定大小的演化和反复出现的记忆. 我们没有匹配模型大小,计算或趋同.

blocks.en: We computed exploratory 95% uncertainty intervals for component comparisons by resampling blocks of generated trials with replacement 2,000 times, stratified by protocol and using the same draws for all models. Blocks can contain repeated photographs. These intervals describe uncertainty over the fixed evaluation protocol, conditional on the trained models; they do not include retraining uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 我们计算了95%的不确定性间隔,用于组件比较,方法是将生成的试验区块重新取样2000次,按程序分级,对所有模型使用相同的抽图。 块可以包含重复的照片. 这些间隔描述的是固定评价协议的不确定性,以经过培训的模式为条件;它们不包括再培训不确定性。

blocks.en: Appendix D Controlled task results
blocks.zh: 附录D 任务结果

blocks.en: For Task 1, we used forty fixed sample–query pairs, twenty matches and twenty nonmatches. For each of seven blank durations (0, 1, 4, 16, 64, 128 or 256), we copied the memory state after the sample and evaluated each copy independently. Images were exposed for one time unit.
blocks.zh: 对于任务1,我们用了40个固定的样本- 火柴对,20个火柴和20个不匹配。 对于七个空白持续时间(0,1,4,16,64,128或256),我们在样本后复制了内存状态,并独立评价每份副本. 一个时间单位的图像被曝光。

blocks.en: For Tasks 2–5, we used twelve photograph-disjoint groups of 64 COCO development photographs. Fixed hashes selected one object instance and rendering per photograph, two images in the same fine-grained category (anchors), and 62 other images (fillers) within each group, without using model responses. Selected photograph and rendering hashes were unique, but the overlap limitations in Appendix A still apply.
blocks.zh: 对于任务2–5,我们使用了12个相片-离合组,由64张CO开发照片组成. 固定散列选择了每张照片一个对象实例和渲染,两个图像在同一细纹类(锚)中,以及每个组内62个其他图像(填充器),没有使用模型响应. 所选照片和渲染散列是独一无二的,但附录A中的重叠限制仍然适用。

blocks.en: For Tasks 2/3, after the sample image we presented sixteen possible four-time-unit slots. Filled slots contained three time units of blank followed by one time unit of a distractor image; unfilled slots were entirely blank. To present 0, 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 distractors, we filled slots in the following order: 8, 4, 12, 2, 6, 10, 14, 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 16. Images were presented in chronological slot order, keeping the sample-response memory age at 65 time units. After each distractor sequence and its mirror, we queried both anchors independently. A separate familiar nonmatching query tested the distractor in slot 8 at response age 33. This distractor appears at every nonzero distractor count; the familiar query is undefined at zero. In these experiments, models responded YES to all positive sample queries, so errors on novel queries were false alarms (YES responses). We counted category responses once per history, not once per query copy.
blocks.zh: 对于任务2/3,在样本图像之后,我们提出了16个可能的4次单位插槽。 填充的插槽包含3个空白的时间单位,然后是1个分散式图像的时间单位;未填充的插槽是完全空白的. 为了提供0,1,2,4,8和16个分流器,我们按以下顺序填充空档:8,4,12,2,6,10,14,1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15,16. 图像按时间档顺序呈现,将样本-反应记忆年龄保持在65小时单位. 在每一个分散器序列及其镜像之后,我们独立地询问两个锚. 单独一个熟悉的不匹配查询在回应年龄为33岁时测试了8槽中的分心器. 这个分光器出现在每一个非零分光器计数处;熟悉的查询在0时未定义. 在这些实验中,模型对所有正面的样本查询都回应是的,因此新问的错误是虚假的警报(YES回复). 我们计算每个历史的分类答复一次,而不是每个查询副本一次。

blocks.en: For Tasks 4/5, after an anchor image we presented a prefix of fillers, with longer sequences nesting shorter ones, then queried either anchor using separate copies of memory. List lengths were 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64 images, and only the final image could repeat. For Task 4, we computed that image’s local recognition score before its memory update and committed the image before the image-free final response. For Task 5, the model forms responses at every image before writing it. For equal-duration blank controls, we replaced all images except the first (target) and final (query) images with blanks for the same total amount of time. All trials began with empty memory and an eight-time-unit trial boundary, retaining first-image attenuation. Images were exposed for one time unit. This control changes both image count and the number of memory updates.
blocks.zh: 对于 Tasks 4/5, 在主播图像之后, 我们给出了一个填充符的前缀, 较长的序列嵌入较短的序列, 然后使用单独的内存副本询问主播 。 列表长度为4,8,16,32和64个图像,只有最终图像可以重复. 对于任务4,我们在更新记忆之前计算了图像的本地识别分数,并在无图像最终反应之前将图像承诺。 对于任务5,模型在写入每个图像之前都会形成响应. 对于等长空白控件,除了第一个(目标)和最后(query)的图像外,我们用同样总时间的空白替换所有图像. 所有审判都以空置的内存和8次单元审判边界开始,保留第一图像的减弱。 一个时间单位的图像被曝光。 此控制既改变图像计数,也改变内存更新的数量.

blocks.en: Table 3: Class-specific repetition results (%). Task 4 shows its image-free final response; Task 5 shows only the response to the final query image. BA averages hit and correct-rejection rates. Blank conditions match elapsed time but contain only the first and last images. All results are averaged over three models and twelve photograph groups.
blocks.zh: 表3:特定类别留级结果(%)。 任务4显示其无图像的最终响应;任务5只显示对最终查询图像的响应. BA平均命中率和正确拒绝率. 空条件匹配过去的时间, 但只包含第一个和最后一个图像 。 所有结果平均分为三个模型和十二组照片。

blocks.en: Exploratory 95% confidence intervals use 10,000 bootstrap resamples of the twelve photograph groups, retaining all conditions and all three fixed models together within each sampled group. At 64 images, image-minus-blank differences in balanced accuracy are − 45.1 -45.1 percentage points [ − 49.3 , − 40.3 -49.3,-40.3 ] for Task 4 and − 27.1 -27.1 [ − 32.6 , − 21.5 -32.6,-21.5 ] for Task 5. These intervals do not reflect uncertainty in training or model selection. Zero-width intervals when models achieve perfect scores do not establish perfect performance on all possible images.
blocks.zh: 探索性95%的置信间隔使用10 000个十二个照片组的靴子套,在每个样本组内保留所有条件和所有三个固定模型。 在64幅图像中,平衡准确度的图像-减-宽差为−45.1至45.1个百分点[−49.3,−40.3至49.3至40.3],任务4为−27.1至27.1[−32.6,−21.5至32.6,-21.5]为任务5. 这些间隔并不反映培训或模型选择方面的不确定性。 当模型实现完美分数时,零宽间隔并不能在所有可能的图像上建立完美的性能.

blocks.en: We used the same twelve photograph groups and three models to evaluate 164 experimental conditions without further training or image selection. In Task 1, we crossed sample exposures of 0.25, 1 and 4 time units with blank durations of 0, 16, 64 and 256; query exposure was always one time unit. We used twelve anchor pairs, one per group, with mirrored histories and independent queries. In Tasks 2/3, we crossed the same four blank durations with six distractor counts. The added blank duration D D followed the complete distraction sequence, giving sample-response ages of 65 + D 65+D and familiar-query ages of 33 + D 33+D . Category responses occur before this added delay and are identical across delay copies. In Tasks 4/5, we crossed five sequence lengths with the same four blank durations for image and blank conditions. The added delay occurred before the final image, not before Task 4’s image-free response.
blocks.zh: 我们用同样的12个照片组和3个模型来评价164个实验条件,没有经过进一步的培训或图像选择. 在任务1中,我们跨越了0.25、1和4个时间单位的样本接触,空白期限为0、16、64和256;查询接触总是一个时间单位。 我们使用了十二对锚,每组一个,有镜像的历史和独立查询。 在"任务2/3"中,我们跨越了相同的四个空白期限,并有六个分心计数. 新增的空白期限DD遵循了完全分散注意力的顺序,给出了65+D 65+D的样本响应年龄和33+D 33+D的熟悉排气年龄。 在任务4/5中,我们跨越了五个序列长度,图像和空白条件与四个空白期限相同。 附加的延迟发生在最终图像之前,而不是任务4的无图像响应之前.

blocks.en: We also evaluated a smaller experiment varying added blank duration (0 and 64 time units), number of images between target and query (0, 3 and 7), and total sequence length (16 and 64 images); only the final image could repeat. Each stream used the last N − 2 N-2 fillers in the predefined order, with the target inserted so that exactly I I images lay between it and the query. Target-response age was I + 1 + D I+1+D time units. The images after the target were identical and in the same order across sequence lengths. We did not change first-image attenuation, response thresholds or Task 4’s controller. The public image-count cue reflects the number of images already seen, not the future sequence length. List length 64 and Tasks 2/3 with 8 or 16 distractors exceed the ranges used during training.
blocks.zh: 我们还评估了一个较小的实验,增加了空白时间(0和64个时间单位)、目标与查询之间的图像数量(0、3和7)以及总序列长度(16和64个图像);只有最终图像可以重复。 每个流在预定义的顺序中使用了最后的N−2 N-2填充器,并插入了目标,这样我就可以在它和查询之间放置精确的图像. 目标响应年龄为I+1+DI+1+D时间单位. 目标之后的图像是相同的,并且顺序相同,跨越序列长度. 我们没有改变第一图像衰减、响应阈值或任务4的控制器。 公共图像计数提示反映了已经看到的图像数量,而不是未来的序列长度. 列出长度64和任务2/3,配有8或16个分散器,超过了训练中使用的范围.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Crossed image-history and delay tests. Values are percentages, averaged over twelve groups and three fixed models. Blue shows correct responses; red shows familiar-wrong false positives. Final memory and repetition use balanced accuracy. Category answers occur before the added delay, and are undefined at zero distractors. The nine planned comparisons are reported in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 图5:跨图像历史和延迟测试. 数值为百分比,平均超过12组和3个固定模式。 蓝色显示正确反应;红色显示熟悉-错误的假阳性. 最后记忆和重复使用平衡的准确性. 分类解答发生在添加的延迟之前,并且在零分辨器时未定义. 计划的9项比较见表4。

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows the crossed delay results; the Task 4/5 panels show conditions with intervening images. We prespecified nine comparisons for this factorial experiment (Table 4 ). The first seven test whether the effect of sample exposure, distractor count or list length changes between zero and a longer blank delay. Task 1 compares exposures of 4 versus 0.25 at delays of 256 versus zero. Tasks 2/3 compare 4 versus 0 distractors for sample balanced accuracy; Task 2 compares 4 versus 1 for familiar-query false alarms, and Task 3 compares 4 versus 1 for complete-trial success. These comparisons use delays of 64 versus zero. Tasks 4/5 compare lengths of 32 versus 8 at delays of 64 versus zero. The final two comparisons, also in Tasks 4/5, test lengths of 64 versus 16 without added delay, equally weighting the three intervening-image counts.
blocks.zh: 图5显示交叉延迟结果;任务4/5小组显示有插合图像的条件。 我们预先确定了这一要素实验的9项比较(表4)。 前7个测试是样本曝光的效果,分心器计数还是列出0到更长空白延迟之间的长度变化. 任务1比较了延迟256对0的4和0.25暴露。 任务2/3比较了4对0的分光器的样本平衡准确性;任务2比较了熟悉的平滑假警报的4对1,任务3比较了4对1的完全审判成功. 这些比较使用了64比0的延迟. 任务4/5将长度为32比8,延迟64比0。 最后两项比较,也是在Tasks 4/5中进行的,试验长度为64比16,没有再拖延,对三次干涉图像计数同样加权。

blocks.en: We computed 50,000 bootstrap resamples of the twelve photograph groups, keeping all conditions and three fixed models together within each sampled group. Bonferroni correction for the nine comparisons gives approximately 99.444% confidence intervals. All seven intervals for interactions with delay include zero; both intervals for sequence length at fixed target recentness exclude zero. Although the comparisons were planned before this evaluation, the photographs had already been examined, so the results remain exploratory.
blocks.zh: 我们计算了5万个靴子 12个照片组的复标 将所有条件和3个固定模型 放在每个样本组内 Bonferroni对9个比较的校正给出了大约99.444%的置信间隔. 延迟相互作用的所有七个间隔都包括零;固定目标最近的序列长度两个间隔都不包括零。 虽然在本次评价之前就计划了比较,但照片已经过审查,因此结果仍然是探索性的。

blocks.en: Table 4 reports the comparisons planned before this factorial evaluation. All contrasts are within tasks. Viewing-time and count comparisons examine the interaction of delay with viewing time (Task 1) or distractor count (Tasks 2–3). Length comparisons examine the interaction of sequence length with delay (Tasks 4–5), or the effect of sequence length at fixed target recentness (Tasks 4–5). In all cases, intervals are adjusted for the nine comparisons in the crossed study. BA refers to balanced accuracy and FPR to false-positive rate.
blocks.zh: 表4报告了在这次要素评价之前计划进行的比较。 所有对比都属于任务范围。 查看时间和计数比较检查延迟与查看时间(任务1)或分心计数(任务2-3)的相互作用. 长度比较审查序列长度与延迟的相互作用(任务4-5),或序列长度在固定目标近期的影响(任务4-5)。 在所有情况下,对交叉研究中的9个比较时间间隔进行调整。 BA指平衡的准确性,FPR指假阳性率.

blocks.en: Table 4: Planned comparisons in the crossed study. Differences are in percentage points; intervals are adjusted across all nine comparisons.
blocks.zh: 表4:交叉研究中的计划比较。 差异以百分点为单位;所有九个比较的间隔都有调整。

blocks.en: Each of nine experimental conditions uses forty trials. Photographs and objects do not repeat between trials within a bank, though banks may overlap. Within trials, objects may reappear with different renderings of the same photograph. Trials were balanced across positions using forty cyclic rotations; images were presented for one time unit, with a total of 64 blank units in Tasks 2/3. Comparisons across banks do not isolate the effects of delay or load.
blocks.zh: 9个实验条件中每个都采用40次试验. 照片和物品不会在银行内部的试验中重复,尽管银行可能重叠。 在试验中,物品可能以同一照片的不同渲染重新出现。 使用40个循环轮替进行各职位的平衡试验;图像为一个时间单位显示,任务2/3中共有64个空白单位。 银行之间的比较不能孤立延迟或负载的影响.

blocks.en: We used sequences of eight images in Task 4 so that we could construct forty photograph-disjoint trials; Task 5 used eight- and sixteen-image sequences. Eight-unit boundaries advanced time and context, with normal memory decay and additional attenuation on the first image of each trial.
blocks.zh: 我们在任务4中使用了8个图像的序列,以便我们能够构建40个相片分离试验;任务5使用了8和16图像序列。 八单元边界提前了时间和背景,每次试验的第一个图像上都有正常的内存衰减和额外的衰减.

blocks.en: All three models used their fixed, source-calibrated response rules in both modes. In carry mode, h h and F F carry over from trial to trial, subject to decay and first-image attenuation; in reset mode, they are cleared. Both modes clear decision summaries at trial boundaries. Scores in carry mode change by between − 0.08 -0.08 and + 0.50 +0.50 percentage points between the first and last ten positions; scores in reset mode do not change (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 所有三种模型在两种模式中都采用了其固定的,源校准的响应规则. 在载体模式下,h和FF从试运行到试运行,可发生衰变和头像衰减;在重置模式下,它们被清除. 两种模式都明确了审判边界的决定摘要。 承载模式中的得分变化在−0.08-0.08和+0.50+0.50个百分点之间,在第一个和最后十个位置之间;重置模式中的得分不变(表5).

blocks.en: The cyclic rotations are not statistically independent: they are different orderings of the same set of forty trials, and context is linked to trial position within a session. They are also not all possible orderings of the trials.
blocks.zh: 循环轮替在统计学上并不独立:它们是同一组40次试验的不同顺序,背景与开庭期间的审判位置相关. 并不是所有审判都可能下达命令。

blocks.en: Table 5: Results with memory carried across trials or reset at the start of each trial (%). Each of the forty trials appears at every position, and results average three models. Tasks 1/2/4/5 show balanced accuracy after pooling binary responses; Task 3 shows complete-trial success. First ten refers to trial positions 1–10 and last ten to 31–40. Reset scores are constant across positions. Changes are descriptive, computed as last minus first before rounding.
blocks.zh: 表5:每次审判开始时携带或重设的内存结果(%)。 40个试验中的每一个都出现在每个位置上,结果平均有三个模型. 任务1/2/4/5在集合二进制响应后显示平衡的准确性;任务3显示完成审判成功. 头十个是审判职位1-10,最后十个是31-40。 重置分数是各位置的恒定数. 变化是描述性的,按四舍五入前最后减数计算。

blocks.en: Appendix E Same-memory readout comparison
blocks.zh: 附录E 同模读出比较

blocks.en: To separate memory from readout ( Davari et al., 2022 ; Anthes et al., 2023 ) , we created pairs of image histories that differed only in the identity of an earlier-presented object, A or B (Figure 6 ). The same query object was repeated after one history and novel after the other. Histories contained 7, 15 or 31 images before the query, with the earlier object appearing 1, 3 or 7 image positions before it; all other images, timings and instructions were identical.
blocks.zh: 将记忆与读取分开(Davari等人,2022年); Anthes et al., 2023 ),我们创建了对图像历史的对映,这些对映历史仅在早先呈现的物体A或B的特性上存在差异(图6 ). 同一个查询对象在一个历史和另一个小说之后被重复. 历史在查询前包含7,15或31个图像,早期的物体在它面前出现1,3或7个图像位置;所有其他图像,时间和指令都相同.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Same-memory readout comparison. Each history was mirrored, changing only the earlier-presented object. The same query was repeated in one history and novel in the other. Within each history, each query and readout used an independent copy of the same aged memory state, before the query image was written. Horizontal comparisons ( Q Q ) assess paired ordering: does the repeated image score higher than the novel image? Vertical comparisons ( H H ) assess history sensitivity: does the same image score higher after the history in which it repeated? Open circles show individual model means; the diamond shows their mean. The bar shows an exploratory 95% confidence interval over 32 photograph groups. Images are illustrative.
blocks.zh: 图6:同模读出比较。 每段历史都是镜像的,只改变早先呈现的对象. 一个历史和另一个小说中重复了同样的询问. 在每一个历史中,每个查询和读出都使用同一个旧记忆状态的独立副本,在查询图像被写入之前. 水平比较(Q Q) 评估配对顺序:重复的图像得分是否高于新图像?. 垂直比较(H H ) 评估历史敏感性:同一图像在重复的历史之后是否得分更高? 开放的圆圈显示单个模型的含义;钻石显示其平均值. 酒吧显示32个照片组的95%的置信间隔是探索性的。 图像是说明性的。

blocks.en: For each history, queries and readouts used independent copies of memory saved before the query’s write. We assessed paired ordering ( Q Q : within each history, did the repeated image outscore the novel image?) and history sensitivity ( H H : did the same image score higher after the history in which it repeated?). Each measure averaged two comparisons, with half credit for ties; no ties occurred. There were 864 four-score cases across nine lag and history-length conditions, 32 photograph groups and three fixed models, with both mirrors included in each case.
blocks.zh: 对于每个历史,查询和读出都使用在查询写入前保存的独立存储副本. 我们评估了配对顺序(QQ:在每个历史中,重复的图像是否超过小说图像?)和历史敏感性(HH:同样的图像在重复的历史之后是否得分更高?). 每项衡量平均进行两次比较,对关系给予一半的信贷;没有关系。 在9个滞后和历史长度条件下,共有864个四分数病例,32个照片组和3个固定模型,每个案例都包含两个镜像。

blocks.en: Averaged over these cases, history sensitivity was high for the trained readout (99.71%) and cosine similarity (99.83%); paired ordering was 96.35% and 99.42%, respectively. Cosine similarity outperformed the trained readout by 3.07 percentage points on paired ordering [exploratory 95% interval 1.10, 5.73], with every model showing an improvement. Of the 63 cases with imperfect paired ordering, 62 had perfect history sensitivity. Cosine similarity corrected 53 of the 63 ordering failures without introducing new failures. Neither metric directly reports recognition accuracy.
blocks.zh: 在这些案例中,经过培训的阅读者(99.71%)和余弦相似性(99.83%)对历史的敏感性很高;配对订购分别为96.35%和99.42%。 余弦相似性在对齐订购上比训练的读取效果高出3.07个百分点[试探95%间隔1.10,5.73],每个模型都显示出改进. 在有不完美配对订购的63起案件中,62起具有完美的历史敏感性。 余弦相似性纠正了63个订购失败中的53个,但没有引入新的失败. 两个计量标准都没有直接报告识别准确性。

blocks.en: Confidence intervals resampled the 32 photograph groups used in previous analyses, with 10,000 iterations retaining all conditions, query copies and fixed models. They do not reflect uncertainty introduced by retraining. The five-task model was unchanged in these analyses: better ordering does not necessarily mean better YES/NO classification, and familiarity signals cannot substitute for matching a query to the designated sample.
blocks.zh: 置信间隔重印了以往分析中使用的32个照片组,10 000个迭代保留所有条件、查询副本和固定模型。 它们并不反映再培训带来的不确定性。 五任务模型在这些分析中没有变化:更好的排序并不一定意味着更好的YES/NO分类,熟悉信号不能取代将查询与指定的样本匹配.
